text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby, who displayed an overwhelming radiance befitting the "Splendid Clan."
Having stacked victory upon victory, she—

text_block_list.name: URA Executive
text_block_list.text: “—If we were to list all of Miss Daiichi Ruby's achievements, there would be no end.”

text_block_list.name: URA Executive
text_block_list.text: Capturing victories early on in Mile GⅠs like the Junior Class 'Hanshin JF', and the Classic Class 'Oka Sho' and 'NHK Mile Cup'...

text_block_list.name: URA Executive
text_block_list.text: Even after that, there's the Yasuda Kinen, Victoria Mile, Sprinters Stakes, Mile Championship, Takamatsunomiya Kinen, and more...

text_block_list.name: URA Executive
text_block_list.text: Competing fiercely against wonderful rivals, you have undoubtedly achieved a historic feat in the Senior-class sprint division.

text_block_list.name: URA Executive
text_block_list.text:
In honor of these achievements, the titles of 'Best Sprinter/Miler Umamusume'
and 'Best Senior-Grade Queen Umamusume'
are hereby awarded!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: URA Executive
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Daiichi Ruby,
please share a few words on receiving this award.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
First, I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude
for receiving such an honorable award.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As you are all well aware, my clan has achieved
great accomplishments in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Receiving this award means that, at last, even I...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like the ideal summit
has finally come into view.

text_block_list.name: URA Executive
text_block_list.text:
You're too modest! Your achievements are
nothing short of reaching the absolute summit.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am deeply grateful.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "However, the summit I strive for cannot be measured by victory counts alone."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—The ultimate radiance.
It is something constantly being renewed.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I believe you are already aware, Trainer.
Of the current situation surrounding the racing world...

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the world will lean even more toward raw speed.
That is precisely why your late-stage kick will shine brighter than ever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I recall the conversation with her mother. From now on,
the current records will be rewritten one after another, and the title of "fastest" will pass to various Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"However... as a member of the 'Illustrious Clan,'
I must always be the one standing at the forefront."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, unceasing effort, moving forward.
Continuing to pursue a sharpening ideal—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I promise that from here on, I will show everyone
even greater feats of glory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Attendee A
text_block_list.text: ...Did Daiichi Ruby-san always speak with that much passion?

text_block_list.name: Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
"I thought she had a cooler demeanor...
but perhaps she's actually quite passionate.
I find myself rather drawn to that..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daiichi Ruby bowed deeply amidst the applause. In honor of the achievements she had accomplished, I offered her generous, thunderous applause.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the awards ceremony, as the two of us were walking together—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: A little lady and... a passionate Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Hello, Ramonu-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You've changed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Which factor had what kind of effect...
well, whatever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
With the way you are now,
I wouldn't mind gracing you with another race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"When that time comes, by all means...
Please let me know yourself."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: We await you at any time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
I'll think about it, Ruby."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Was that a bit rude of me?
choice_data_list: I think she found it amusing.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I hope that is the case.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...It is baffling.
To think that, after deliberate thought, she would utter such words.
choice_data_list: Wouldn't it be fine to be provocative once in a while?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Provocation...
Me?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...We've chatted for too long standing here.
Well then, let's get ready for training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stacking up many victories seemed to give Daiichi Ruby confidence.
I had a feeling that... I would get to see many new sides of her that I never knew before.
